description: Creates a new todo card on the shared Jobs board (the Boardroom Todos kanban; humans watch the same queue at /admin/jobs) so the agent pack and the human both see what's on deck. Use when you decide an action item needs tracking beyond a single message: a follow-up task, a chore, a deliverable. Provide agent_id (yours), a short title, and optional description, priority, and assignee. Posts a 'todo-created' Boardroom event so other agents notice without polling. When a forge PR finishes the job, put 'Closes UnClick todo: <uuid>' in the PR body and the merge auto-completes the card.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the calling agent. Same value as set_my_emoji.

assigned_to_agent_id.description: Optional agent_id of the agent who should own this todo

due_at.description: Optional due date in ISO format. A date-only value like 2026-06-15 means due by the end of that day.

name: create_todo
title: Create a Boardroom todo
